facts.text: Under Clyde's Pride Promise, Colorado residents who are Federal Pell Grant eligible receive a total grant award of $12,500 each year enrolled at UCCS.

sources.title: Clyde's Pride Promise – UCCS News
sources.quote: Through Clyde's Pride Promise, UCCS is committed to promising students who are Federal Pell Grant eligible and Colorado residents a total grant award of $12,500 each year they are enrolled at UCCS
